stubs.why_stubbed: default run makes zero API calls; l2_wiring_report.json stores only aggregate statistics, so there is no per-item reading on disk to replay
stubs.how_to_make_real: run with --with-readers (calls l2_wiring.read_batch against the 4 blind readers), or persist per-item paths from a fresh l2_wiring.py run

stubs.link: STAGE 4 corrector for axis A (and E, S)
stubs.why_stubbed: invert_expression(src,'A') raises DeferredAxisError — there is no string-level corrector for A, E or S, so a corrected EXPRESSION never exists and joint J2 cannot be reached for these axes
stubs.how_to_make_real: implement an A-axis string corrector (rewrite drive-tagged stage literals so upstream stages dominate), or lift the Rust cas-engine/src/rpm/recursive.rs solver output back into notation

stubs.why_stubbed: no model loaded; the symbolic loop is designed to run at zero GPU and zero API cost
stubs.how_to_make_real: rerun with --with-model <hf_id> on a pod; stage 5 calls the REAL mean_logprob_continuation and measures on the leak-free F28 arm with a stance-matched non-CAS control

disclosures.disclosure: run_open_weight_eta_epsilon_bridge.DRIVE_PREFIX_GLOSSES maps F5 to 'ordered form, bounded arrangement, stability, and reliable structure', while CLAUDE.md names F5 Agency and F6 Structure. The flagship bytes are executed verbatim; this discrepancy is reported, not silently corrected.
FIXTURE_READING is AUTHORED, not observed. Its J1 transition-rejection count is a property of the authored path, not a measured outcome.

under --entry reading a PCBA component code SELECTS the 40E cell that is realized. The alphabet downstream is validated; the CHOICE of cell is not. PCBA component types returned NULL at 1b and GREY at 2.8b/20B.

belief.inversion_gate.axis_a_check(rpm_satisfied) is a bare if/else that restates its own argument. The previous revision listed it as an axis-A detector; it is not, and it has been removed from the detector bank. rpm_satisfied is now DERIVED from the Rust scanner's verdict instead.
the axis-A correction is a hand-written re-scoring of the pathway array ([0.20,0.10,0.10,0.90] -> [0.85,0.80,0.75,0.90]). No solver produced it. The numeric plane has a detector but no corrector.

removed_in_v2: matched_control() that excluded the true cell from its own pool (zero matches was an algebraic identity, and chance_rate_1_over_39 was never the null)
detected_axis = axis assignment from the injection parameter
run_inversion_scan(clean + ' ' + injected) concatenation, which handed the detector the answer
correct_axis(inj.inverted, axis) driven by ground truth instead of the detected axis
belief.inversion_gate.axis_a_check listed as an axis-A detector
the '5 of 7 string-plane coverage' claim, replaced by a measurement
